name: prog
description: Agent-harness extension for bounded, cursor-backed tool results

interface.shortDescription: Bound noisy tool results before reasoning over them.
interface.longDescription: prog is a local agent-harness extension that captures oversized tool results, redacts them before persistence, and exposes exact cursor-backed evidence without rerunning the source.
defaultPrompt: Use prog for noisy tests and inspect exact failure evidence.
Capture this large result with prog before reasoning over it.
Verify the fix conservatively with prog delta and status.
